text:
Maya: Kicking off the Ambassador Toolkit pilot tomorrow AM. Objective: validate training labs + cert rubric with two SIs (one HW partner + one cloud SI) and ship a lightweight sales cheat sheet.
Connor: Which SIs landed on the pilot roster?
Maya: VectorGrid (HW partner) and CloudForge (SI). Added a tiny intake form here: https://drive.redwood/ambassador-toolkit-pilot (responses pending).
Aisha: Heads-up: VectorGrid asked for a quick network baseline test and a sample systemd service file for the runtime.
Rob: I can add the systemd example to the lab repo. AMI is baked and in staging (ami-0bcd1234). I'll share the tag in the doc.
Connor: Thanks. For the rubric, let's score over three axes: Deployability (0-5), Troubleshooting (0-5), Documentation Quality (0-5). Pass threshold = >=12 and no critical fails.
Maya: I like that. Also include a customer-runbook submission as a pass gate.
ops-bot: Reminder: calendar invites sent for "Ambassador Toolkit 1 Pilot" 09:30-11:30 local. Please RSVP.
Aisha: Training labs - proposed modules:
```
1) Marketplace install + config overlay
2) Runtime tuning (batching, kv cache)
3) Failure injection & recovery
4) Security & KMS key rotation demo
5) Runbook co-author exercise
```
Connor: Add a short lab for 'model rollback + canary route' too. It trips a lot of SIs.
Maya: Good call. We'll add a 20-min canary exercise after install.
Rob: I'm updating the marketplace listing screenshots (new instance type) and the quickstart readme. Will push before the sessions start.
Aisha: Who's owning the sales cheat sheet? Need a one-pager with handoff checklist and contact template for SI engineers -> AE handoff.
Connor: I'll draft the sales one-pager and include a snippet for partner co-branding language.
Maya: Co-marketing plan: short technical blog + webinar if pilot cohort passes. Quick blurb needed for partner comms if they clear cert.
ops-bot: Note: preflight checklist available at scripts/si/pilot-preflight.sh. Run 45 minutes before session.
Rob: Also adding a tiny bash network probe for the runbook: `for i in 1 2 3; do curl -sS -m 2 https://internal.redwood/netprobe || echo fail; done`
Aisha: Can someone confirm access for CloudForge to the staging project? They need IAM role permissions for deployments.
Connor: I invited cloudforge@partners to the staging account with ci-deploy role. They should get the invite.
Maya: Action items recap: Rob = push screenshots + systemd example + AMI tag, Connor = sales cheat sheet + invite CloudForge, Aisha = finalize lab step scripts & rubric, Maya = partner comms blurb + webinar plan.
Aisha: I'll also assemble a short feedback form for SIs after each lab; want to capture friction points.
Maya: Perfect. We'll run the first session live and record. If pilot looks good we'll scale to a 10-SI cohort next quarter. :rocket:
Connor: Joining the first session.
Rob: Joining.
ops-bot: Auto-note: run `scripts/si/collect-logs.sh` after lab for trace capture.
Maya: Thanks team, check-in after session 1 for go/no-go on blog.
